scoring_justification: Full ab initio recompute from raw wavefunctions not feasible in the verifier sandbox; the checker compares agent-reported D_e and rho to paper-reported values with tolerances (T0 result-level compare).

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for dissociation energy D_e (kJ/mol) and charge density at hydrogen-bond critical point rho_bcp (a.u.) for all 17 BASE-HF complexes.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 (dissociation energies) and Table 2 (charge density at hydrogen-bond critical point).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values extracted directly from the paper's tables as reproduced in the article markdown.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values the paper reports; the reference solution (solve.sh) outputs them and the checker uses them as the target for reproduction.

outputs.description: CSV file with one row per BASE-HF complex, containing the computed dissociation energy and the charge density at the hydrogen-bond critical point. The checker compares these values to hidden reference values from the paper within prescribed tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The CSV must include all 17 complexes: OC–HF, SC–HF, NN–HF, HCN–HF, H3N–HF, OOO–HF, SCO–HF, OCO–HF, NNO–HF, OSO–HF, H2CO–HF, H2O–HF, HF–HF, H3P–HF, H2S–HF, HCl–HF, HF–HCl. The complex column should use the same naming convention as shown here.
